# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game titled **Main Character Sniper: Chrome Aftershift**. Preserve a mobile FPS/sniper loop: menu, Sniper FPS and Ghost Run modes, drag-to-aim/drag-to-move, tap FIRE, target dossier based on jacket/neon attributes, reticle-center hit detection, wrong-hit panic, target kill success, Ghost Run ammo/signal/camera/exit behavior, and restart/menu states.

Reframe it as: Fps. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around sniper game play, with competitive, futuristic, leaderboard energy, after work session design, search-friendly hooks like sniper game, shooter, fps, aesthetics like chrome aesthetic, cyberpunk, neon aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as no scope, main character. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Use a chrome cyberpunk city, neon scanlines, procedural crowd silhouettes, scope rings, competitive leaderboard HUD language, meme no-scope feedback, and one-thumb controls. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/JS with approved catalog fonts Orbitron, Rajdhani, and Press Start 2P.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source game truth
The source is a browser-native canvas shooter with two modes. Sniper FPS mode starts from a menu, generates a neon city/crowd, lets the player drag the scoped camera, and fires at the reticle center. A target NPC is identified by jacket and neon hints; hitting that target wins after a short delay, while wrong hits or misses trigger panic feedback. Ghost Run mode preserves the same target/crowd world but adds joystick movement, finite ammo, camera surveillance, signal/cover loss, a temporary cloak, guards, target kill, and exit-wall victory.

## Protected mechanics
- Start/menu/end/retry state flow.
- Sniper drag-to-pan camera and FIRE button input.
- Reticle-center hit detection around NPC body/head.
- NPC generation, target identification by visual attributes, panic behavior, target kill/win.
- Ghost Run movement joystick, ammo, signal, cameras, cloak, guard aggression, exit condition.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, HUD vocabulary, world nouns, palette, background motifs, procedural shapes, feedback text, menu copy, end-state language, font application, and reaction media are safe to transform.

## Rebuild target
A single canonical `index.html` delivers Main Character Sniper: Chrome Aftershift, a satirical cyberpunk mobile FPS/sniper experience with chrome scope UI, no-scope meme feedback, competitive leaderboard language, and one-thumb portrait-first controls.
